startup_status.details: The application started successfully using the .venv2 virtual environment. Pygame 2.6.1 initialized correctly with SDL 2.28.4. Main entry point (main.py) launches correctly.

dependency_check.details: All required dependencies (pygame, random, typing) are properly installed and functional in .venv2 environment. Note: 'uv sync' fails on Windows due to pygame build requirements, but .venv2 has pygame pre-installed.

module_imports.details: All core modules imported successfully without errors.

game_initialization.details: Game class initialized successfully with proper setup of pygame display, clock, fonts, game state, platform, falling blocks, landed blocks, physics engine, camera, and scoring system.

main_game_loop.details: The main game loop executed for 120 seconds without crashes or errors. The game loop properly handles input, update, and draw cycles. In headless mode, processed 17951 frames in 120 seconds at ~150 FPS.

block_spawning.details: BlockSpawner creates falling blocks correctly with random sizes (from BlockSizes) and colors. Blocks spawn at the top center of the screen.

falling_blocks.details: Blocks fall with proper gravity simulation using Physics.GRAVITY and variable fall speed that increases with difficulty.

block_landing.details: Blocks properly detect collision with platform and other blocks. Landing mechanism works correctly, updating score and spawning new blocks.

physics_engine.details: PhysicsEngine handles collision detection, center of mass calculations, and balance checking. Balance status determination (stable, unstable, collapsed) is operational.

scoring.details: Score increases by 10 (Scoring.POINTS_PER_BLOCK) for each successfully placed block. Height bonus (+50 points every 5 levels) is properly calculated. Full test reached score of 3770 with ~377 blocks placed.

camera.details: Camera smoothly follows the tower height using interpolation (0.1 factor) in _update_camera() method.

game_reset.details: _reset_game() method correctly resets all game state variables to initial values.

supported_controls.ESCAPE: Quit game or reset when game over

input_handling.details: All keyboard controls are properly registered and processed in the _handle_input() method. Input handling works correctly in headless mode via AI interface.

elements: Center of mass visual indicator (colored circle)
Game over overlay with final score and restart instructions
ui_rendering.details: All UI elements are implemented and render correctly using pygame font rendering. Platform drawing with center line works properly.

ai_interface.details: AI interface methods (get_observation(), step_ai()) are implemented and functional. Provides observation dictionary with block position, rotation, dimensions, stack center of mass, tower height, score, and game over state. step_ai() returns (observation, reward, done) tuple. Observation is populated after update() call.

state_space.details: State space correctly includes: block position (x, y), block rotation (0-270 degrees), block dimensions (width, height), stack center of mass, tower height, score, and game over flag.

action_space.details: Action space correctly supports: 0 (move left), 1 (move right), 2 (rotate), 3 (do nothing). step_ai() method properly executes all actions.

reward_function.details: Reward function includes base oscillation penalty (-0.1), positive reward for successful block placement, and large negative penalty (COLLAPSE_PENALTY) for collapse.

error_handling.details: No errors or exceptions were thrown during the 2-minute runtime analysis. The application ran stably without crashes during extended testing (17951 frames).

performance.details: Game runs at or above target 60 FPS using pygame.time.Clock.tick(). Performance is smooth and consistent. Headless mode runs faster without display rendering.

notes: The game successfully runs for extended periods (2 minutes) without stability issues.
Pygame display initializes correctly (800x600 resolution as per config).
The .venv2 virtual environment contains all required dependencies.
The game is designed for interactive play but also supports AI-controlled gameplay through the step_ai() method.
Headless mode (SDL_VIDEODRIVER='dummy') works correctly for unattended testing.
Simple AI strategy (alternating left moves and rotations) successfully reached score of 3770 without tower collapse.
Observation dictionary is populated after update() call - empty before first update.
'uv sync' fails on Windows due to pygame build requirements, but .venv2 has pygame 2.6.1 pre-installed.
recommendations: The .venv2 environment should be included in the project or documentation should mention using it on Windows.
For unattended testing, headless mode with SDL_VIDEODRIVER='dummy' works well.
